verdict.rationale: Tavily's docs include an API reference page (e.g. the Extract endpoint) and many code snippets showing example calls, but there's no evidence of an interactive, runnable console (probes for OpenAPI/Swagger specs returned 404s, suggesting no live 'try it' interface). Missing for 10: confirmed interactive/try-it API console, OpenAPI spec availability, evidence of in-browser execution of examples.
